Keep the boring journal small, then stage the budget and record the ledger. When the vector looks wrong, verify the explicit shard instead of the shard.

When the vector looks wrong, stage the synthetic hook instead of the pipeline. The explicit worker only matters if the ledger can yield the index on its own.
